jia_releng: deploybot warns of a slow drift in p95 on canary during change window. Autorevert may trigger. Should we hold and pin, or let auto rollback?

deploybot: ALERT: Canary p95 (/generate) increased to 1.9s (threshold 1.6s). Autorevert in 90s unless overridden. telemetry: https://telemetry/redwood/1735008

omar_oncall: oncall here. Any 5xxs or just latency?

sasha_eng: only latency spike on longer prompts. Traces point to a new batching heuristic that sometimes disables prefix caching. Suspect PR #602. No 5xx.

toni_sales: FYI some pilot customers on dedicated lanes may be sensitive to tail latency. If prod is touched we need a CSM note.

jia_releng: propose: short manual hold so engineering can revert the batching heuristic on canary, run smoke, then promote. If revert fails, pin prod route to stable model.

omar_oncall: OK applying hold. `deploybot override --thread 1735008888 --hold 600 --reason "investigate batching heuristic"`

deploybot: ACTION: Autorevert HOLD applied by omar_oncall for 600s. Manual rollback still allowed.

sasha_eng: reverting PR 602 on canary now: `git revert 602 && infra/deploy --env canary --tag v3.5.2-rollback-batch`

sasha_eng: revert deployed at 1735008925. smoke logs: `smoke: p95 1.3s; no 5xx; kv-cache hits restored`.

toni_sales: thanks. I'll draft a short CSM blurb: "Canary observed increased tail latency due to a batching heuristic; we reverted the change and verified no customer impact in prod. Will monitor for 30m."

jia_releng: promoted canary at 1735008960. I'll add release-note fragment and link PR.

omar_oncall: canceling hold. `deploybot override --thread 1735008888 --hold-cancel`

deploybot: NOTICE: Autorevert HOLD canceled by omar_oncall. Normal autorevert policy restored.

sasha_eng: filing follow-up ticket to add a CI eval for batching heuristics and a config gate (ENG-ops-204).

jia_releng: closing loop 5B2 release-notes updated and CSM notified. Good teamwork. :thumbsup:
